semiconductor_relevance: High — Preferred Networks develops specialized AI semiconductors and infrastructure, directly contributing to the semiconductor value chain.
summary: Preferred Networks (PFN) focuses on creating AI computing infrastructure through the co-design of software and hardware. They are showcasing their MN-Core L series, an AI semiconductor optimized for high-speed inference, and the MN-Core 2 Devkit, which supports diverse AI applications.
capabilities: MN-Core L series for AI inference
MN-Core 2 Devkit for development and demonstration
Comprehensive support for hardware and software integration
